$comment: Ported from Light Modern and Dark Modern, github.com/microsoft/vscode extensions/theme-defaults/themes (light_modern.json, dark_modern.json; MIT, Copyright (c) 2015 - present Microsoft Corporation). Colours the files leave to VS Code come from its colour registry defaults.
name: VS Code
author: Microsoft, ported for Switchboard

$comment: canvas is editor.background, accent is button.background (= focusBorder).
popover is editorWidget.background (light_modern has no menu.background); muted is descriptionForeground.
ok is gitDecoration.addedResourceForeground, error is editorError.foreground (errorForeground #f85149 is too light on white for text), caution is gitDecoration.modifiedResourceForeground.
warn ("needs you") is the terminal's magenta #bc05bc: the theme has no colour for that state. unread is the link blue.
diff-added and diff-removed are VS Code's defaults for diffEditor.insertedTextBackground and removedTextBackground.
canvas is editor.background, accent is button.background (= focusBorder).
popover is menu.background; muted is descriptionForeground. code-bg is editor.background: Dark+ comments (#6a9955) fall under AA on textCodeBlock.background (#2b2b2b).
ok is gitDecoration.addedResourceForeground, error is errorForeground, caution is editorWarning.foreground.
warn ("needs you") is the terminal's bright magenta #d670d6: the theme has no colour for that state. unread is the link blue.
diff-added and diff-removed are VS Code's defaults. The terminal is panel.background with VS Code's default ANSI colours and selection (editor.selectionBackground).
